Introducing the Ondo Network, the execution layer for open financial markets, and the evolution of our vision for Ondo Chain.

Fast and private like a CEX. Verifiable like a blockchain. Non-custodial in design.

How it works:

→ Enclaves for private, high-speed execution
→ Decentralized attestors for verifiability
→ Blockchains for asset transfer settlement

The first application powered by the Ondo Network is @OndoPerps, the high-performance perpetual futures platform.

But the Network is not a perps-specific system. It is general-purpose infrastructure for any application that needs execution speed, privacy, and distributed, verifiable correctness. Spot markets, structured products, lending markets, and more can all be built on it.
